paper.title: EvolveR: Self-Evolving LLM Agents through an Experience-Driven Lifecycle
paper.central_claim: EvolveR's closed-loop lifecycle (offline self-distillation of trajectories into a scored principle base, online retrieval, and GRPO policy update) outperforms strong agentic baselines on multi-hop QA, with self-distillation beating teacher distillation at 3B.

provenance.notes: actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref not exposed to the worker; model_type is the controller-assigned type.

rationale: In scope via retained principle base (weights also trained). Good split and ablation set; raw-memory/gate-off controls, stats and cost parity missing.

evidence.quote: This loop employs a policy reinforcement mechanism to iteratively update the agent based on its performance.
evidence.support_explanation: Weights are also updated (GRPO) alongside the non-weight experience base.

evidence.quote: However, this reliance on raw cases struggles to generalize and, more importantly, fails to abstract.
evidence.support_explanation: Author gap vs raw-trajectory memories.

evidence.quote: While resource-efficient, this approach treats such reflections as a transient hint, leaving the agent's intrinsic policy unchanged.
evidence.support_explanation: Author gap vs external-scribe reflection memories.

evidence.quote: the model reviews each trajectory and, based on its outcome, distills the core strategic insight into a concise natural language statement.
evidence.support_explanation: Principle distillation from success and failure.

evidence.quote: then prompt the agent model to provide a binary semantic equivalence judgment.
evidence.support_explanation: Dedup/merge via embedding prefilter plus LLM equivalence check.

evidence.quote: each principle tracks its usage and success counts, enabling the computation of an empirical score that reflects historical performance.
evidence.support_explanation: Utility score is usage-success ratio (not counterfactual).

evidence.quote: whose training splits are used to build the experience base
evidence.support_explanation: Experience base built on NQ/HotpotQA train; evaluation on test and 5 OOD sets.

evidence.quote: it is determined by an exact match with the ground truth
evidence.support_explanation: Outcome reward / success label is gold exact match.

signatures.object: Experience base of scored natural-language principles with triples (non-weight), plus policy weights via GRPO
signatures.information: Agent's own trajectories with gold-EM outcome; gold labels used for success/failure
signatures.operation: Self-distill guiding/cautionary principle per trajectory, embedding+LLM dedup/merge, usage-success score, prune below 0.3, retrieve top-3 at test
signatures.conditions: Offline phase alternating with online RL phase
signatures.selection_rule: Novelty via sim<0.85 or LLM inequivalence; periodic prune by score
signatures.persistence: Milvus vector base with provenance links to trajectories
signatures.later_use: search_experience action in later episodes and at test
signatures.failure_boundary: Self-distill bounded by agent capability; 0.5B worse than teacher; noise at 50k entries (0.410->0.387)

claims.text: The distill-retrieve-RL lifecycle improves QA over Search-R1 and prompting baselines.
claims.setting: Qwen2.5 0.5B-7B; NQ/HotpotQA train-built base; 7 QA sets
claims.baseline_control: RAG, Search-R1, SFT, rejection sampling, ablations
claims.selection_vs_test: Base built on train splits; OOD sets evaluation-only
claims.result_denominator: EM per dataset, average; single run
claims.allowed_conclusion: Combined distilled-principle retrieval plus RL beats the tested baselines at 3B/7B on held-out QA; store contribution about 0.04 EM at 3B when retrieval removed.

claims.text: Self-distillation beats a stronger external teacher at 3B.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Small difference without variance; reversal at 0.5B and mixed at 1.5B.

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: A self-built, pruned principle base built on train data improves later held-out QA when retrieved by an RL-trained 3B/7B policy; improver-level not shown.

G.reason: Specific gap (raw-case recall does not abstract; external scribing leaves policy unchanged) with Reflexion/ExpeL/Mem0/G-Memory named, but neither raw-case memory nor ExpeL is a baseline so residual is not demonstrated.

M.reason: Success/failure distillation, dedup-merge, usage-score pruning and RL that trains the policy to call and use retrieved principles form a coherent chain with predictions (self vs teacher distill, retrieval ablation).

X.reason: Prompts, thresholds (0.85 sim, 0.3 prune, k=3), loss masking and loop phases are given; unclear is offline-phase cadence versus RL steps, whether the base is frozen at test, staleness of principles from old policies, and credit in usage counts.

E.measurement.reason: Exact-match (and F1 in part) on seven standard QA benchmarks against gold answers; strict and trustworthy, EM-defined reward.

E.causality.reason: Store-off at inference, distillation/retrieval/RL attribution grid, self vs teacher distiller, SFT vs RL updater, absorb variant; missing raw-trajectory-memory baseline (core contrast), gate-off ablation (threshold sweep is flat), cold-start/baseline parity.

E.holdout.reason: Experience base from NQ/HotpotQA train, in-domain test plus five out-of-domain sets evaluated exclusively; no contamination audit and checkpoint/selection protocol for reported numbers not given.

E.statistics.reason: Single run per setting, no seeds or intervals; conclusions rest on gaps of 0.01-0.02 (0.382 vs 0.370, flat pruning sweep); sample sizes for Bamboogle not stated; negative variants (absorb, 0.5B teacher reversal) are reported.

E.cost.reason: Training hours and retrieval latency with base size reported; no cost of LLM distill/dedup calls or compute-matched comparison to Search-R1 and teacher-distill (GPT-4o-mini) variants.
